title: Foil-Baked Tuna with Mixed Greens
blurb: Fresh tuna steaks baked in foil parcels with a simple seasoning, served over peppery mixed greens
steps: Cut four large squares of aluminum foil and place a tuna steak in the centre of each.
Drizzle each steak with olive oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Finely chop the chives and scatter over the tuna, then fold the foil into sealed parcels.
Place the parcels on a baking tray and bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the tuna is just cooked through.
Meanwhile, divide the mixed greens between four plates.
Unwrap the tuna steaks and place one on top of each pile of greens, spooning over any juices from the foil.
Cut the lemon into wedges and serve alongside for squeezing over.
